id: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones (2002)

ops.old: Flathead pieces in a crisp salt and vinegar crumb, fried golden, with a sharp dill pickle and caper tartare and lemon wedges. Cut 600g flathead fillets into bite pieces and soak in 3 tbsp malt vinegar for 10 minutes, then pat dry. Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 100g panko mixed with 1 tsp salt. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden. Mix 150g mayonnaise with chopped dill pickle, capers, dill and lemon juice. Sprinkle the fish with more salt and vinegar.
